claims.claim: Implemented immutable, revisioned REPAIR supersession records with strict predecessor, failure identity, continuity, and unique-current-tip resolution while preserving legacy authorization compatibility.
Supersession fails closed for stale authorization identity, invalid canonical state, or an already-admitted continuation without rewriting historical REPAIR refs.
Unified State, correction preflight, operator admission, wakeup, and dispatch bind the exact current authorization SHA, which is retained in admitted correction lineage.
The existing REPAIR lifecycle and action semantics remain intact, including Executor and verification ownership rules.

Added deterministic regressions covering immutable CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION-to-FINALIZE_CANDIDATE supersession, legacy preservation, stale selection, continuation refusal, malformed chains, idempotency, and stale wakeup rejection.
All implementation changes are confined to the explicitly authorized files and committed at the reported HEAD.
